title: German Christmas Market Tasting Tour
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Taste the festivities at Quebec City's German Christmas Market, featuring nearly 90 local artisans and producers for your enjoyment! Discover the warm, festive atmosphere of this European-style market in the heart of Old Quebec on a tour combining Quebec and German culture. Sample typical German products, including spiced mulled wine. This is your chance to experience the magic of Christmas!

MPORTANT: Please note that this tour takes place rain or shine, every day of the year.
